verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents its own full-text thread search across sender, recipients, subject and body, ranked by relevance. Threads can be retrieved scoped to one inbox or across the whole organization, which covers ranked keyword search and a basic scope filter. missing for 10: documented search operators/query syntax, richer filters (date, label, attachment, etc.) applied to search, evidence of search speed, explicit coverage of full mail history, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, search is fast and precise — operators, filters, and ranked results across my full mail history

citations.quote: Full-text search finds Threads by keyword across the sender, recipients, subject, and message body, ranked by relevance.
you can retrieve them in two powerful ways: scoped to a single `Inbox` or across your entire `Organization`.
